process_steps.input_state: mirror-polished cubes of Ti-18Nb and Ti-30Nb wrapped in Ta foil

evidence.quote: The solid-state bonding step was carried out in a creep test machine at 950 C, under an Ar–2 pct H2 flow with a pressure fixed between 3 and 5 mbar. During the 1-hour isothermal hold, a constant compressive load for a pressure of about 10 MPa was applied using a weight system.

The proper diffusion treatment was performed under dynamic vacuum (5 9 10 /C05 mbar). The sample was again wrapped in a Ta foil and heat treated at 1500 C for 24 hours, with heating and cooling ramps of 7 C/min.
Additional thermal treatment in the b-domain at 800 C for 15 min under vacuum was subsequently performed, followed by water quenching.
The sample was then sliced and cold-rolled with 85 pct thickness reduction, with the rolling direction (RD) perpendicular to the direction of the composition gradient.

parameters.cooling_method: air-quenched by removing glass tube from furnace without breaking vacuum

other.wrapping: Ta foil in glass tube inserted directly in hot furnace
